basics.text: **本条为著录级条目。**以上各项照录克利夫兰美术馆的藏品记录，字段名标明「馆方」者即其原文。本库尚未对其作独立核校，亦未就断代、归属、风格作任何判断——分期归入依据仅为：朝代名 → yuan；器类归入依据仅为：type=Painting。

items: Jiao yu bu di er ci quan guo mei shu zhan lan hui zhuan ji [敎育部第二次全國美術展覽會專集 = A special collection of the second National Exhibition of Chinese Art under the auspices of the Ministry of Education]. [Nanjing?]: Shang wu yin shu guan, 1937.（vol. 1, cat. no. 68）
Wang, Chi-ch'ien 王季遷. An Exhibition of Authenticated Chinese Paintings, April 1948. New York: C.T. Loo, 1948.（cat. no. 8）
Rowland, Benjamin. Masterpieces of Chinese Bird and Flower Painting; A Loan Exhibition. October 30-December 14, 1951. Cambridge, MA: Fogg Art Museum, 1951.（cat. no. 15）
Caro, Frank and Hsien-Chi Tseng. Loan Exhibition of Chinese Paintings. Toronto: Royal Ontario Museum of Archaeology, 1956.（cat. no. 7）

dating.text: 馆方著录中有含纪年的款识（见「题跋与鉴藏」一节），其年份与馆方断代一致，故断代依据可以填「款识」而不再是无从得知。**只给「较可靠」不给「确证」**：本库未核对原件，款识本身的真伪、是否后添均未独立判定。
款识原文未经本库目验；馆方亦未说明其对该款识真伪的判断。

colophons.text:
至正丁亥春 錢塘王淵若水寫秋景鶉雀圖
[印] 澹轩; [印] 若水; [印] 墨妙筆精

馆方英译：Artist's inscription, signature, and 3 seals: In the year of Zhizheng, spring of dinghai [1347], Wang Yuan, Ruoshui of Qiantang, drew this picture of Quails and Sparrows in an Autumn Scene. 
[seals] Danxuan; Ruoshuii; Mo miao bi jing.

翦翦輕風搖翠葆，團團清露滴金叢。
劍南畫手今何在，冷落賓榔枸杞新。
鐵篴
[印] 杨维桢印; [印] 廉夫

馆方英译：1 poem and 2 seals of Yang Weizhen (1296-1370): 

How lovely is the light breeze that stirs the verdant foliage./ 
Like pearls the fresh dew drips over the golden groves./ 
Where is the painter now, who hailed from Jian’nan?/ 
Like the leftover betel nut, it is being replaced with fresh goji berry.

Tiedi.
[Seals] Yang Weizhen yin; Lianfu
1 inscription and 10 seals of the Qianlong emperor (r. 1736-95)
4 seals of Zhang Heng 張珩 (1915-1963)
